hook_en: The secret way to shrink a PDF under 100 KB. Comment 'PDF' and I'll send the link.
hook_hinglish: PDF ko 100 KB ke neeche karne ka secret tareeka. 'PDF' comment karo, link bhej dunga.
angle: A student gets 'file too large' on the form portal at the last minute, then a friend whispers a secret free tool and the size panel drops from 2 MB to 90 KB.

hook_en: Your photo is 3 MB but the form wants 20-50 KB. Fix it in 10 seconds.
hook_hinglish: Photo 3 MB ki hai aur form ko 20-50 KB chahiye. 10 second mein fix.
angle: A job seeker has minutes before the application closes and the photo keeps getting rejected, then the resize turns the error red into a green success.

hook_en: Open your Aadhaar PDF without remembering the password rule.
hook_hinglish: Aadhaar PDF khol lo, bina password ka chakkar yaad kiye.
angle: A character is locked out of the e-Aadhaar file and tries wrong passwords, then the tool opens it in three taps.

hook_en: 5 PDF problems you can solve for free, starting with this one.
hook_hinglish: 5 PDF problems jo free mein solve ho jaati hain, pehli yeh wali.
angle: A narrator and a counter run through five tiny scenes, with merging ten scanned pages into one file as scene one.

hook_en: Free background remover, no app, no watermark. Comment 'BG' for the link.
hook_hinglish: Free background remover, na app, na watermark. Link ke liye 'BG' comment karo.
angle: A character pays a studio for a passport-style cutout and is shocked when a friend does it free on the site.

hook_en: Your bank statement PDF can turn into Excel in one tap. Nobody tells you this.
hook_hinglish: Bank statement PDF ek tap mein Excel ban jaata hai. Koi batata nahi.
angle: An intern is retyping a long statement by hand while a colleague quietly shows the converter, and the rows fill in a table at once.

hook_en: Signature must be 10-20 KB? Stop re-clicking photos of your signature.
hook_hinglish: Signature 10-20 KB chahiye? Baar baar signature ki photo khichna band karo.
angle: A junior keeps getting a rejected upload from the boss's portal, and the boss shows the signature resizer that gets a green tick.
